message.reasoning: User wants to fill fuel tank and then convert gallons to liters. Need to know how much to fill. We have fuel tank capacity 50 gallons. Current fuel level? From car_info: FuelRange 560 km remaining, but no exact fuel level. We can assume we want to fill to full capacity. So fuelAmount = 50 - currentFuel? But we don't have current fuel. We can ask for current fuel level. Use get_current_speed? No. There's no function to get current fuel level. We can approximate by using fuel range and consumption. But simpler: ask user how many gallons to add.
